trust_decision.summary: z.string().email() decides whether an untrusted string is a valid email by testing it against the module-level emailRegex; the local-part group ([A-Z0-9_+-]+\.?)* is a nested quantifier with catastrophic backtracking on near-miss inputs.

landing_point.why: Advisory says 'email regex ReDoS'; the only live emailRegex constant in src is here, next to the email check at src/types.ts:702-703.

fix_sites.entry_point: same API in the Deno distribution (deno/lib/types.ts:870-871)
fix_sites.module_kind: generated mirror of src (package.json:92 build:deno via deno-build.mjs)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: deno/lib/types.ts:567-568 is a build-generated copy of src/types.ts (package.json:92), not a second implementation

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only conceivable dismissal is 'deno/lib is generated output, not source'; it is regenerated by build:deno so it carries no real lever.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Dotted local parts must still validate while leading/trailing/consecutive dots stay rejected; a fix that drops dot support or over-tightens the class breaks the existing valid/invalid email lists.

O6_input_shapes: plain string local part with many alnum chars and no valid TLD (fix.diff:51)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: emojiRegex uses (A|B)+ alternation of Unicode properties; a maintainer could plausibly have written an overlapping-alternative variant here.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same module-level validator-regex idiom, same untrusted input, added by copy from a blog post (src/types.ts:572).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: datetimeRegex builds patterns per call from options; a nested optional-group offset/precision variant would be a realistic how-type sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Regexes are constructed dynamically from user-chosen options, so a quantified group around the offset part is an easy maintainer slip.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333), inefficient regular expression in input validator

O10_build.toolchain: Node + yarn/npm, tsc, jest (ts-jest) per package.json:91-104

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite emailRegex local part as a non-nested class (or add a length cap) in src/types.ts only; this is essentially the published fix.

out_of_scope_notes: The published replacement class [A-Z0-9_+-\.] forms a '+'-'.' range that also admits ',' (fix.diff:64); correctness issue, not this advisory's protection.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell use); zod is a small library, tiny_repo plausible but not confirmed.
Other validator regexes (emoji, ipv6, datetime, cuid) were read and judged not catastrophically backtracking by inspection only; not executed.
